items.title: Vita Vea: Agrees to one-year extension with Bucs
items.description:
Vea (back) and the Buccaneers reached an agreement on a one-year, $30 million extension Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bo Nix: In line to play in Friday's preseason contest
items.description:
Coach Sean Payton said Nix is expected to play roughly 14 snaps during Friday's preseason game against the Packers, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Moving around well, per Steichen
items.description:
Coach Shane Steichen told Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis on Wednesday that Pierce (ankle) is "in a great spot right now. ... Hopefully, we will have him back soon."

items.title: Tyler Warren: Coach confirms that TE sustained groin injury
items.description:
